about_the_game:
A dragon egg has bonded with you as the Devourer's shadow falls upon the sacred hatchery. Race across the treacherous island to collect allied hatchlings and reach the protective summit shrine before it finds you!

Hatch Dinos!

Each Dino comes with their own card pool, choose wisely! You can control your play style by choosing which Dino type can join your party. (you can always pass and find another egg) 

DeckBuilding

Draw the cards from your deck, throughout the game you'll have many opportunities to discover more!

Command Your Dinos!

Command your Dino's by playing their cards from your hand.

Fight Devourer's Minions!

Command your Dino's BEFORE engaging combat! 

Key Features

  • Dynamic Deck Building: Choose your cards wisely! Discover hundreds of cards to add to your deck with each attempt

  • An Ever-changing Island: Whenever you embark on a journey through the Island, the path layout differs each time. Choose a risky or safe path, face different enemies, choose different cards, discover different artifacts, and fight different primal bosses!

  • Powerful Artifacts to Discover: Powerful items known as artifacts can be found throughout the Island. The effects of these artifacts can greatly enhance your deck through powerful interactions. But beware, obtaining a artifact may have dire consequences...

  • Dynamic Party Building: Hatch eggs, recruit up to three Dinos, and shape a party that fits your playstyle

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: 2.5 GHz Quad-core Intel or AMD processor
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 470 GTX or AMD Radeon 6870 HD
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: The game includes graphics settings to aid lower end devices.

short_description: Single-player roguelike deckbuilder. Hatch dino eggs, build your deck around a three-dino party, play your hand, then let the clash unfold.
